Section 1: Introduction
This Blueprint Document has been prepared for Archlin to define the supply management solution approach for an enterprise planning implementation in the context of Archlin’s specialty chemicals manufacturing business. Archlin operates with SAP S/4HANA as its ERP system and has an integrated planning environment with some automation already in place. The Phase 1 scope is focused on Supply Management, with particular attention to addressing Archlin’s current pain point

Section 3: Supply Chain Scope
The high-level scope for Archlin is to provide supply management capabilities as part of Phase 1, supporting its specialty chemicals manufacturing planning environment on SAP S/4HANA. The focus of this phase is aligned to Archlin’s current planning maturity, where integrated planning with some automation is already in place, but poor inventory planning remains a key business pain point. The intended scope is therefore centered on improving the supply-side planning process and establishing a clearer foundation for procurement, manufacturing, and distribution planni

The Blueprint also recognizes that several advanced or extended capabilities are identified but are not necessarily part of the initial implementation. For example, inventory optimization is described as not considered in the initial implementation, and expiry-based replenishment exclusion is noted as not considered in the initial implementation, with reporting feasible if considered in a later release. Demand sensing and AI capabilities, advanced forecasting algorithms using external causal factors, and certain advanced forecast-related capabilities are similarly described as not in the scope

3.1  Supply Chain Maps
Archlin’s supply chain map for Phase 1 is required to represent the supply management scope and provide a graphical view of the supply network supporting procurement, manufacture, and distribution of Archlin products. The available source material identifies that the high-level scope of this phase is to provide demand, supply, and inventory planning capabilities supporting procurement, manufacture, and distribution; however, for Archlin, the stated Phase 1 scope is supply management, with the key business pain point being poor inventory planning.
